# Data Dictionary – `student_performance.csv`

## Data source (please read)
**This dataset is SYNTHETIC.** It was generated by `src/generate_dataset.py` (seed 42) using a documented
statistical model. It is **not** real student data and was not collected from any institution or public
repository. It is intended only to demonstrate a machine-learning workflow. Relationships in it (for example,
that marks depend mostly linearly on earlier performance) are assumptions built into the generator, not
findings about real students.

* Records: 1,200 students, no duplicate records.
* About 1% of cells in 5 columns (Gender, Attendance_Percentage, Study_Hours_Per_Day, Sleep_Hours,
  Extracurricular_Participation) are **deliberately left blank** to exercise the imputation step.

## Columns

| # | Column | Type | Range / Values | Description | Role |
|---|--------|------|----------------|-------------|------|
| 1 | `Student_ID` | text | STU0001 – STU1200 | Unique identifier | Identifier (not used as a feature) |
| 2 | `Age` | integer | 18 – 23 | Age in years | Feature |
| 3 | `Gender` | categorical | Male, Female | Gender as recorded | Feature |
| 4 | `Attendance_Percentage` | float | 0 – 100 | % of classes attended | Feature |
| 5 | `Study_Hours_Per_Day` | float | 0 – 12 | Average self-study hours per day | Feature |
| 6 | `Previous_Semester_Marks` | float | 0 – 100 | Overall marks in the previous semester | Feature |
| 7 | `Assignment_Score` | float | 0 – 100 | Average score on submitted assignments | Feature |
| 8 | `Internal_Exam_Marks` | float | 0 – 100 | Marks in internal/mid-term examinations (scaled to 100) | Feature |
| 9 | `Assignments_Completed` | integer | 0 – 10 | Assignments completed out of 10 | Feature |
| 10 | `Class_Participation_Score` | float | 0 – 10 | Instructor-rated participation | Feature |
| 11 | `Sleep_Hours` | float | 3 – 12 | Average sleep per night (hours) | Feature |
| 12 | `Extracurricular_Participation` | categorical | Not Involved, Occasional, Regular | Level of extracurricular involvement | Feature |
| 13 | `Final_Exam_Marks` | float | 0 – 100 | Final examination marks | **TARGET** (never used as an input) |

## Derived label (not stored in the CSV)
`Performance_Category` is computed from `Final_Exam_Marks` (or from *predicted* marks) by `src/utils.py`:

| Category | Marks |
|----------|-------|
| Excellent | 85 – 100 |
| Very Good | 70 – 84.99 |
| Good | 55 – 69.99 |
| Average | 40 – 54.99 |
| Needs Improvement | below 40 |

The project brief was cut off after "Average: 40–", so the Average upper bound (54.99) and the
"Needs Improvement" band are assumptions. Edit `CATEGORY_BANDS` in `src/config.py` to change them.

## Leakage note
`Final_Exam_Marks` and anything derived from it (including `Performance_Category`) are excluded from the
model inputs. The model uses only the 11 feature columns above.
